_aide: Retouches du chapitre 3. RÈGLE : les consignes décrivent les positions DANS L'IMAGE (« the hand on the LEFT side of the image, near his hip »), jamais « his left hand » (gauche/droite du personnage ≠ gauche/droite de l'image). UN SEUL changement par tâche. Lancer : npm run preparer -- 3 --suivante (mode à la main) ou npm run illustrer-lot -- 3 (mode API) ; --essai pour voir sans rien faire. "ignorer": true = mise de côté. Guide : docs/outil-illustration.md

taches.note: Kaï court face à nous : la main levée à DROITE de l'image est bandée (c'est sa main gauche) alors que la main basse à GAUCHE de l'image est nue.
taches.consigne: REMOVE the bandage from the raised open hand on the RIGHT side of Kaï (the hand held up next to Mory, on the right side of the image): it must be bare brown skin.

taches.note: À faire APRÈS l'acceptation de la tâche précédente (même case).
taches.consigne: ADD a white bandage wrapped around the hand hanging low on the LEFT side of Kaï's body (near his hip, on the left side of the image), like a medical bandage over the back of the hand and knuckles.

taches.note: La main portée à la joue (côté GAUCHE de l'image) est bien bandée ; la main en bas à DROITE ne doit pas l'être.
taches.consigne: REMOVE the bandage from the hand at the BOTTOM of the image, just to the RIGHT of the purple hoodie (low, near the bottom edge): it must be bare brown skin. Keep the bandaged hand held against the cheek on the LEFT side of the image.

taches.note: La main sur la poitrine (milieu de Kaï) est bien bandée ; la main en bas à DROITE ne doit pas l'être.
taches.consigne: REMOVE the bandage from the hand at the BOTTOM RIGHT of Kaï's body (hanging low at the bottom edge of the image, just right of his hoodie): it must be bare brown skin. Keep the bandaged hand held against his chest in the middle of the image.

taches.note: Déjà fait (retouche acceptée le 12/10) : mains et regard de Kaï corrigés.
taches.consigne: REMOVE the bandage from the hand hanging at the BOTTOM RIGHT of Kaï's body (low at the bottom edge of the image): it must be bare brown skin. Keep the bandaged hand scratching his head on the LEFT side of the image.

taches.note: La main qui tient le livre rouge (milieu-gauche de Kaï) est bien bandée ; la main basse à DROITE ne doit pas l'être.
taches.consigne: REMOVE the bandage from the hand hanging low at the BOTTOM RIGHT of Kaï's body (below Mory's outstretched hand, near the bottom edge of the image): it must be bare brown skin. Keep the bandaged hand holding the red book at the middle-left of Kaï.

taches.note: Des traits de pluie traversent toute la pièce ; la pluie ne doit rester que derrière les vitres à GAUCHE.
taches.consigne: REMOVE all the rain streaks that cross the room: no rain in front of Kaï's face and hoodie, in front of the bookshelf on the RIGHT side of the image, or on the purple wall in the CENTER. Rain must stay ONLY behind the glass of the windows on the LEFT side of the image.

REMOVE all the rain streaks that cross the room: no rain in front of the two people, the table or the big purple window in the CENTER. Rain must stay ONLY behind the glass of the window on the far LEFT side of the image.

taches.note: Un manche de batte relie les mains de Kaï au livre rouge ; il doit tenir le livre lui-même.
taches.consigne: REMOVE the grey baseball-bat handle that runs between Kaï's hands (center-left of the image) and the red book (center of the image): his two hands, with the bandaged hand on the LEFT side of the image, hold the red book itself by its left edge, arms outstretched. The book stays in the same place, hitting the crystal.

taches.note: L'horloge indique environ 11 h au lieu de 10 h.
taches.consigne: The round wall clock at the TOP CENTER of the image (above the central bookshelves) must show exactly 10:00: the short hour hand pointing at the 10 (upper left of the dial) and the long minute hand pointing straight up at the 12.

taches.note: Les deux garçons à la porte (à DROITE de l'image) doivent être Kaï et Mory ; leurs fiches seront jointes car la consigne les nomme.
taches.consigne: CHANGE the two soaked boys standing in the doorway on the RIGHT side of the image: the boy on the LEFT of the pair becomes Kaï (short curly high-top hair, wet purple hoodie, headphones around his neck) and the boy on the RIGHT of the pair becomes Mory (big afro, glasses, navy jacket with cyan lines). Both are soaked from the rain, same size and same position as now.
